package rulefixtures

import (
	"bytes"
)

// scenario for bytes_buffer_string_len: `len(buf.String())` instead of `buf.Len()`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario446Positive(data []byte) int {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	for _, b := range data {
		buf.WriteByte(b)
		_ = len(buf.String())
	}
	return buf.Len()
}
